## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Cyclical leadership is evident (Industrials/Energy/Financials showing ABOVE TREND names such as DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND), while Tech is mixed — style: Value/Cyclical favored.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +0.16%) ABOVE TREND and broad utility strength. Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials showing weakness: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND and DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) in CORRECTION. Consumer Staples soft: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION. Technology is internally mixed (positive 1W but 1M weakness) with several big-cap techs below trend.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors), signaling cyclical tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select tech and materials names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (GOOGL, AMZN, UNH show 1W/1M mismatch) so treat gains tactically.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, internal rotation with pockets of strength. AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND; sector shows 1W support but 1M pressure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials skew constructive with top names above trend but mixed internals. JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND anchors strength while PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY and V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND highlight dispersion.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive characteristics but no broad leadership. JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION and UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY show mixed signals, while LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND underscores uneven internals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select commodity/ex-energy exposure given DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap tech names showing sustained 1M weakness such as MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND. Monitor RECOVERY setups (SHOP, AMZN, GOOGL) for confirmation before scaling positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (strong earnings/guidance led by DE), Energy (OXY strength), Utilities. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples showing near-term weakness and profit-taking.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch continuation above recent 1W highs for AMAT and DE to confirm RISK-ON thrust; failure below 1W lows for MSFT and INTC would signal deeper tech pullback; a break below short-term support on SHOP and AMZN would invalidate RECOVERY setups.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DE (+80): Deere surging on upbeat earnings — DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+80): FDA breakthrough news but JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION — short-term weakness vs bullish catalyst is a divergence. OXY (+55): Dividend hike lifted OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. LLY (+60): Positive trial news but LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — bearish price action despite bullish headlines.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-50): Negative aeronautics/reporting headlines align with BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND — confirmed weakness. AMZN (-45): Criticism on cash flow while AMZN (1W: +5.27% | 1M: -9.17%) RECOVERY — sentiment is bearish but price is showing short-term strength (distribution risk).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND show leadership. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (GOOGL, AMZN, UNH in RECOVERY) and mixed sentiment (JNJ/LLY headlines vs short-term weakness) — monitor for trend confirmation.
